advisor.reasoning: San Diego 26-Nov: current max ~70°F (21.1°C), ceiling 77°F, needs +7°F more. It's 17:55Z (9:55 AM local) with CLR sky and NNW 7.4 m/s onshore wind already established — this is a sea-breeze regime suppressor. Forecasts cluster 79-82°F (NWS 82, GFS/metno ~79) but upstream stations cap at 70.6°F with 7 m/s onshore flow. The diurnal curve peaks hour 13-14 local (~80°F) but that's model output; the live onshore wind at this hour acts as a sea-breeze that pins coastal SAN well below inland values. Run_max 70°F with 12°F pace deficit and no mechanism to clear the marine inflow before afternoon peak. Model p_exceed only 15%. Position requires >77°F; onshore flow makes that unlikely.
